name: The Singing Vines
introDiscord:
Long silver vines hum whenever the current moves through them. Some
repeat old melodies. Others improvise. Somewhere among the vines, a
Serpent has learned harmony.
introTwitch:
Long silver vines hum whenever the current moves through them. Some
repeat old melodies. Others improvise. Somewhere among the vines, a
Serpent has learned harmony.

the-singing-vines-approach.prompt:
Three rootways pass beneath curtains of humming vines. Each route sings
a different melody.

left.message:
Broad kelp wraps a Star Candy cache beneath vines playing a gentle
three-note refrain. Opening the bundle adds an accidental fourth note.

right.message:
One vine sings slightly off-key.

Then it opens its eyes.

That explains the artistic disagreement.

forward.message:
Restorative sap rests beneath Shizuki's note:

'Tried singing with vines.

Vines copied me.

Glimmer copied vines.

I have been outnumbered musically.'
forward.fullHpMessage:
You leave the sap untouched. The vines continue performing without
requiring another vocalist.

the-singing-vines-depths.prompt:
The melodies overlap as three passages twist through a natural
underwater concert hall.

left.message:
A smooth harmony follows you between the roots.

One note gets louder.

And closer.

A Singing Vine Serpent uncoils from the melody.

right.message:
A moss-covered shrine coffer opens beneath vines playing what sounds
suspiciously like a victory song.

Premature, but encouraging.

forward.message:
One Berry rests beside Shizuki's handwritten lyrics:

'Berries berries berries~

Glimmer says I need second verse.

I disagree.'

the-singing-vines-threshold.prompt:
Towering kelp forms Resonant Arbor. Three final routes hum in perfect
three-part harmony.

left.message:
A moonblossom pool sits beneath a vine humming softly enough to feel
like a lullaby.

Shizuki wrote:

'Excellent nap vine.
Five stars.'
left.fullHpMessage:
You leave the restorative pool untouched and allow the five-star nap
vine to continue its work.

right.message:
A Singing Vine Serpent answers the Arbor's harmony with one long note.

Then it moves into the path.

Soloist detected.

forward.message:
An offering basket has been woven directly into the singing vines.
Inside are Star Candies that gently rattle in rhythm.

boss-antechamber.name: Resonant Arbor
boss-antechamber.prompt:
Every vine in the Arbor stops singing.

One deeper melody remains.

bossPromptDiscord:
The Resonant Arbor answers with a single low note.

The roots vibrate.

The vines bend.

A much larger harmony begins moving through the chamber from somewhere
you cannot see.

Use /yes to enter the Arbor or /no to leave the final performance for
another night.
bossPromptTwitch:
The Resonant Arbor answers with a single low note.

The roots vibrate.

The vines bend.

A much larger harmony begins moving through the chamber from somewhere
you cannot see.

Use !yes to enter the Arbor or !no to leave the final performance for
another night.
bossRetreatText:
You retreat from the Arbor. The hidden melody continues behind you,
patiently holding the final note.

boss.revealText:
The vines split apart as an enormous Serpent coils through the singing
roots.

Canticle Serpent reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Canticle Serpent disappears beneath the Arbor.

The vines resume their music.

For several seconds, they play Shizuki's berry song.

Oh no."
